title: Railway RRB NTPC 10+2 Under Graduate CEN No. 07/2025 Exam City/ Admit Card 2026 for 3058 Post
intro: Railway Recruitment Board (RRB)  has Officially Released Exam City/ Admit Card for the Post of Non-Technical Popular Category (NTPC) 10+2 Inter Level (CEN: 07/2025) Recruitment 2025 for 3058 Post. Exam Date 07-09 May & 13, 14, 15, 16 to 20 June 2026 & Admit Card Available On May, 2026. All Interested Candidates Can Download Exam City/ Admit Card Now in the Given Link Below.
importantDates: Last date for Application fee payment for the submitted application : 06 December 2025
Exam Admit Card: 04 Days Before Exam Date
CBT Exam Date :  07-09 May & 13, 14, 15, 16 to 20 June 2026
General / OBC  Candidates : Rs.500/- (Rs. 400/- Refunded After Appear Stage I Exam)
SC / ST / PH/ All Female Candidates : Rs. 250/- (Rs. 250/- Refunded After Appear Stage I Exam)
Payment Mode: Pay the Exam Fee Through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking Fee Mode Only.
Maximum Age : 30 Years (UR/ EWS) Born Between 01-08-2008 to 02-01-1996
Maximum Age : 33 Years (OBC-NCL) Born Between 01-08-2008 to 02-01-1993
Maximum Age : 35 Years (SC/ ST) Born Between 01-08-2008 to 02-01-1991
Read the Notification for Age Relaxation.

Selection Process: Selection on basis of Online Exam  (Stage I, II) & Aptitude Test, Skill Test, DV & Medical
Important Instruction for the All Candidates Expect the Fee Concession Categories.
Candidates Must be Enter the Your Account Number, Account Holder Name, IFSC Code Under Login Section.
Railway Will be Refunded General/ OBC/ EWS Candidates Rs. 400 & SC / ST Candidates Rs. 250/-
After the Appear the First Stage CBT Examination Your Exceed Amount Will be Refunded at Your Bank.
Note : If you have Not Appeared in CBT Exam Amount Not be Refunded.
